sources.name: Wikipedia - List of S&P 500 companies
sources.use: current constituents (503), modern GICS sector, SEC CIK
limitations: sector labels are modern GICS, not point-in-time
crowd-maintained; not an official S&P record

sources.name: Wikipedia - Historical components of the S&P 500
sources.use: index changes for point-in-time membership reconstruction
sources.coverage_evidence: 409 change rows 1976-07-01..2026-09-21; reconstructed membership 505-508 names at each pilot formation end (index has ~503-505 securities)
limitations: completeness unverified; ticker renames not recorded
removed tickers may since have been reused
no identifiers beyond ticker and name

sources.name: Yahoo Finance via yfinance 1.7.0
sources.use: pilot-window daily OHLCV, Adj Close, dividends, splits, history metadata
sources.endpoint_semantics: end exclusive: probe MMM 2015-01-28..2015-02-03 returned last date 2015-02-02
sources.retrieved_utc_window: 2026-10-04T02:14:13Z..02:15:11Z (approx.; 58 s fetch ending 3 min 23 s after the 02:11:48Z timer start)

adjustment_conventions.Close: split-adjusted, NOT as-traded (AAPL 2015-07-31 Close 30.325 vs as-traded 121.30)
adjustment_conventions.Adj Close: split- and dividend-adjusted; matches (Close+Div)/Close_prev returns to p99 1.8e-05
adjustment_conventions.Volume: split-adjusted (Close x Volume = as-traded dollar volume)
adjustment_conventions.Stock Splits: includes spin-off price adjustments encoded as fractional splits (e.g. EBAY 2.376 on 2015-07-20, BAX 1.841 on 2015-07-01)

limitations: no as-traded prices; raw-close $5 rule applied to split-adjusted Close (conflict)
former S&P members largely absent (115 former-member tickers returned no rows)
levels embed later split events including holdout-period ones
terms of use restrict redistribution; raw data not committed

sources.name: Existing financial-data connector (MCP)
sources.finding: schema offers historical S&P 500 constituents and non-split-adjusted EOD prices, but only via interactive per-symbol tool calls; not scriptable from repo code; plan/licence unknown

identifiers.permanent_security_id: none available free; Yahoo ticker used (symbol fallback)
identifiers.issuer_id: SEC CIK for current members; normalized Wikipedia security name for former members

delisted_coverage: poor: former members mostly missing from Yahoo; excluded and counted per formation (no_yahoo_data)
